comment: The features ui-look.js shows, one entry each: what it is, its look steps and window test checks, and the settings and commands of package.json that belong to it. A feature the window cannot show says why in notInWindow. A feature that works through Agent Plus also names, under agentPlus, the settings, commands and views of Agent Plus's package.json it uses; agentPlusOther lists the rest of Agent Plus's, with why they are not this extension's. test/parts/77-ui-look-features.js checks these lists against package.json and against the Agent Plus it finds, and the window test against the Agent Plus it installed.

features.what: Patching Codex's installed files at start-up, the prompt to reload, and Remove the Patch putting Codex's own files back until Turn On reapplies it
The work plan plugin installed into Codex, trust for its hooks, and the commands that install it again, download Python, trust the hooks and stop Codex loading it
Codex Plus's Codex button on the editor tab bar in place of Codex's own, opening a new conversation in a tab or Codex's sidebar as codexPlus.tabBarButton says
checks: tab bar

features.what: A Codex tab's title following the conversation's name, including a conversation started in a tab

The dot on a Codex tab's logo by what the conversation is doing: a green dot while a turn runs, a green ring while only something it started still runs, red while it waits for permission, and none once it has stopped
checks: the dot on a tab
a question the work plan put to the user
a conversation waiting for you in the background
a question answered while its turn runs
